summary: Vehicle-subsystem driver called from GamePostMainLoop: iterates i from 0 while i < dword_5C329C (vehicle count), passing the i-th element of the pointer array at dword_7C54F0 to TireTemperatureSimStep each pass, then returns the vehicle count. Advances the per-vehicle tire-temperature simulation one step for every active vehicle.

operations.description: Loop counter i starts at 0 and increments each pass while i < dword_5C329C (the vehicle count).
For each index, call TireTemperatureSimStep with the i-th element of the pointer array at dword_7C54F0 (dword_7C54F0[i]), i.e. one vehicle pointer per iteration.
Return the vehicle count dword_5C329C as the result.
